item.title: United Way recognizes '211 Day' in West Virginia
item.description: United Way branches across West Virginia promoted the 211 hotline on Wednesday to raise awareness for the multiple services available to vulnerable community members.

item.title: Restaurant Road Trip: Little Paris Cafe
item.description: On this week's Restaurant Road Trip, we're giving you a little taste of Paris, right here in north central West Virginia.

item.title: Miss Regina Maria partners with Marion County bank to give Valentine's Day gifts to children
item.description: Franchesca Aloi, also known as Miss Regina Maria, has partnered with Freedom Bank in Farmington by taking up Valentine's Day cards and toy donations for children needing encouragement.

item.title: Diversified Energy donates sports bras to Morgantown student athletes
item.description: Representatives with Diversified Energy, along with other volunteers, welcomed female student athletes into the gym at South Middle on Wednesday to donate sports bras, along with other goods.

item.title: West Virginia voter information will not be sent to the DOJ: Secretary of State
item.description: West Virginia Secretary of State Kris Warner announced Wednesday that West Virginia will not voluntarily provide personal information about its registered voters to the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ).

item.title: Shinnston American Idol star reads books to elementary students
item.description: Recent American Idol star and Shinnston native Olivia Spino visited Big Elm Elementary School on Wednesday for a meet and greet and book reading event.

item.title: West Virginia State Trooper rescues elderly man trapped for 5 days
item.description: An elderly man is alive and receiving medical treatment after being trapped in his home for five days.

item.title: Part of US 250 to be closed in Marion County for a month
item.description: A particular stretch of U.S. Route 250 will once again be closed in Marion County as crews work on repairs and maintenance in the area.

item.title: Fairmont Human Rights Commission speaks out against ICE
item.description: At Fairmont City Council’s meeting Tuesday night, the Fairmont Human Rights Commission (FHRC) spoke out against actions by Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) in Fairmont.

item.title: 10-year-old at Mountaineer Elementary texted threat to 911, deputies say
item.description: Several police units were on the scene at Mountaineer Elementary School in Harrison County on Wednesday after police say a 10-year-old texted a threat to 911.
